Migration023 adds nullable planned_start_on without a default/backfill, a validated universal deadline CHECK using due_on or the Manila day of due_at, and update_work_schedule. The command uses current core/edit/date-manager authority, active term/unarchived/mutable workflow restrictions, READ COMMITTED graph lock before receipt/row locks, expected version, exact payload/key retries, changed row/version and redacted audit/outbox. Canonical work deduplicates naturally; contributions use real task IDs/receiving committee, other tasks use assigned/lead committee, deliverables use lead committee. Actual participation badges do not grant access. Phase is the deliverable's own phase; tasks retain null, with no private parent inheritance. Real status, dates/original targets, overdue and neutral required-dependency/pending-handoff blocking are projected. Strict filters, inclusive date overlap with explicit unscheduled inclusion, deterministic end/null-last/ID ordering and100-row page cap. Only both-loaded permitted dependency endpoints are returned, distinguishing required versus informational links. No hidden parent/source/file/finance metadata.
